title.en: The American Staffordshire Terrier needs at least 60 minutes of exercise every day.
title.sl: Ameriški staffordshirski terier potrebuje vsak dan vsaj 60 minut gibanja.

why.en: That's why your adult dog's daily goal is 6,000 steps.
why.sl: Zato je dnevni cilj tvojega odraslega psa 6.000 korakov.

facts.quote: Pet parents should aim for at least 60 minutes of exercise daily, which can be broken down into smaller sessions.

title.en: A dog the size of the American Staffordshire Terrier reaches its adult weight at about 12–15 months.
title.sl: Pes takšne velikosti, kot je ameriški staffordshirski terier, doseže odraslo težo pri približno 12–15 mesecih.
